name: Falls Rock and paired falls composition

approval.note: W0 design proposal only; not drawn, gated, approved or available for placement.

variants.note: One authored rock, paired falls and basin section; detail uses shared water, cliff and old-town families.

story.lore: Keep the old town’s origin between the Glint’s two falls as one unique geographic landmark.

todo: Purpose: Keep the old town’s origin between the Glint’s two falls as one unique geographic landmark.

Visual brief: Two distinct falls split around a solid inhabited rock; strong dark cliff depth, a visible upper water rim and foam collecting in the ria below. Old stone fronts sit on actual rock shelves.
Implement after review: Claude selects the design, draws it, supplies exact anchors/collision and passes the library gate; no concept may ship.
Geometry: proposed authoring envelope 40x22 cells; one cell is 8 world px / 24 art px. This is not an asserted solid footprint; collision, foot and overhang await the drawing.
Scale: 288-world-px drop is in the older brief; do not force it into prototype two-cell earth faces. Claude must settle the landscape section before drawing.
Rule proposal: both upper channels have sources/outlets, each falls into its basin and neither crosses occupied rock/door cells.
The gallery behind the falls is explicitly a proposal in the brief; no new door or hidden traversal is created by this concept.
